label: Rosa (carer → coordinator)
tagline: Two decades of care: aide, nurse, coordinator, and the Sunday table that held a whole family together.

entries.title: Looking after Abuela
entries.body: Weekends at Abuela's: cards, soup, and being trusted with the medicine box list. Care started before it had a name.

entries.title: Sunday lunches begin
